title: DDS AutoDiag command line (dds-autodiag)
keywords: autodiag this tool cli command line commands dds-autodiag doctor check collect compare topics inspect sample demo selftest bench serve json exit code ci
text: The dds-autodiag command: doctor (is this machine ready), check (diagnose this host; --peer FILE.json compares with another snapshot, --transport accepts only auto, intra_process, dds_shm, dds_udp or dds_tcp — never rmw — and sets the expected transport, --report writes Markdown), collect (save a snapshot, --redact hides hostnames and IPs), compare PEER.json [OTHER.json], topics, inspect /topic (endpoints, QoS and incompatibilities), sample /topic (AutoDiag's own probe waits for one real message), demo (two broken demo topics, diagnosed), selftest (tool check: every rule against its synthetic faults — not a live robot test), bench (benchmark AI models) and serve (the dashboard). --json gives machine-readable output, and the exit code is 0 for no problem, 1 for a problem and 2 for a usage error, so it works as a CI gate.
